# Hello printmd

A free web tool to **style and print** your Markdown as PDF instantly.

## Features

- Real-time preview
- 5 theme presets
- Custom styling
- PDF export

## Code Block

```javascript
const hello = 'world';
console.log(hello);
```

## Table

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Editor | CodeMirror 6 based |
| Preview | markdown-it rendering |
| Theme | 5 presets available |

## Blockquote

> Print your Markdown beautifully!

---

*Made with printmd.*

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I convert Markdown to PDF?
faq.a1: Simply drag and drop your .md file into printmd, choose a theme, and click print or save as PDF. The entire conversion happens in your browser — no upload required.
faq.a2: Yes, printmd is completely free. No signup, no usage limits, and no hidden costs.
faq.q3: Does printmd upload my files to a server?
faq.a3: No. All processing happens client-side in your browser. Your documents never leave your device, ensuring complete privacy.
faq.q4: What Markdown features are supported for PDF conversion?
faq.a4: printmd supports headings, bold/italic/strikethrough, ordered and unordered lists, code blocks with syntax highlighting, tables, blockquotes, images, links, and horizontal rules.
faq.q5: Can I customize the PDF output style?
faq.a5: Yes. Choose from 5 built-in themes (GitHub, Notion, Academic, Minimal, Dark) or apply custom CSS for full control over the PDF output.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I print a Markdown file?
faq.a1: Open your .md file in printmd by dragging and dropping it, choose a theme, and press Ctrl+P (or Cmd+P on Mac) to print. The output is optimized for clean printing.
faq.q2: Does the printed output include syntax highlighting?
faq.a2: Yes. Code blocks are printed with full syntax highlighting for 50+ programming languages, preserving colors on your printed pages.
faq.q3: Can I print tables from Markdown?
faq.a3: Yes. Markdown tables are rendered as clean, formatted tables in the print output with proper borders and alignment.
faq.a4: Yes. printmd automatically handles page breaks so your content flows cleanly across printed pages without cutting through code blocks or tables.
faq.q5: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a5: No. printmd works entirely in your browser. Just visit the site, drop your file, and print. No installation or signup required.

about.title: About printmd
about.subtitle: Free Markdown to PDF tool for everyone
about.description: Learn about printmd, a free online tool for editing Markdown and converting it to beautifully styled PDFs.
about.missionDesc: We believe everyone should be able to create beautiful documents easily. printmd was built to bridge the gap between writing in Markdown and producing professional-looking PDFs — all without installing software or creating an account.
about.whatDesc: printmd is a free, browser-based tool that lets you edit Markdown and instantly convert it to styled PDFs. Whether you are a developer writing documentation, a student preparing assignments, or a professional formatting reports, printmd makes it simple.
about.featureEditorDesc: CodeMirror 6-based editor with syntax highlighting and real-time preview.
about.featureThemesDesc: GitHub, Notion, Academic, Minimal, and Dark styles to choose from.
about.featurePdfDesc: Convert your Markdown to PDF with one click. Print-optimized output.
about.featurePrivacyDesc: All processing happens in your browser. No data is sent to any server.
about.featureI18nDesc: Available in English and Korean with full localization.
about.featureExtensionDesc: Convert GitHub README files to PDF directly from GitHub pages.
about.whoDesc: printmd is an independent project created by a developer who wanted a better way to turn Markdown into print-ready documents. We are committed to keeping printmd free and accessible to everyone.
about.openDesc: printmd processes everything client-side. Your documents never leave your browser. We use Google AdSense to support the service, and Google Analytics to understand usage patterns — no personal data is collected beyond standard analytics.
